profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Architect | AI & Cloud Specialist (AWS)
profile.summary: I am a Full-Stack Architect, I’m leveraging AI to redefine technical hiring. With over 10 years of experience at organizations like Bank of America , I specialize in building high-performance, scalable web applications. My expertise lies in the intersection of modern frontend frameworks (Angular 17, RxJS) and robust cloud architectures (AWS, Docker, CI/CD).

positions.title: Full-stack Developer / Architect
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	Architected and developed two enterprise applications from scratch using Spring Boot (backend) and Angular (frontend), defining system architecture, design patterns, and best practices. 
•	Led full SDLC lifecycle including requirement gathering, architecture design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
•	Designed and developed scalable RESTful microservices, ensuring high performance, security, and maintainability. 
•	Implemented reactive programming using RxJS and state management using NgRx for scalable frontend data flow. 
•	Designed responsive UI using CSS Grid, Flexbox, SCSS, and Angular Material, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and accessibility. 
CI/CD, DevOps & Automation:
•	Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines from scratch using Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Ansible Tower. 
•	Onboarded XLR (Release Orchestration) for multiple Agile teams to streamline release management. 
•	Integrated Datical for automated database deployments and version control across environments. 
Security & Secrets Management:
•	Led implementation of secure credential management, migrating service credentials to Vault. 
•	Automated service ID and password rotation, ensuring secure runtime retrieval of credentials from Vault before establishing connections. 
•	Played a key role in infrastructure architecture decisions, improving system scalability and reliability. 
•	Led migration from Windows-based application servers to Linux environments for both frontend and backend systems. 
•	Designed and maintained Oracle and MS SQL Server databases, including schema design and performance optimization. 
•	Deployed and managed applications on AWS, utilizing services such as S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Lambda, and API Gateway. 
•	Designed and developed a data lineage scanning system to analyze ETL pipelines, Bitbucket repositories, and file systems. 
Achievements:
•	Awarded a patent for data visualization innovation within banking systems.

positions.title: Senior Architect
positions.description: Architected and developed enterprise metadata, data quality and lineage applications using Spring Boot, Angular, REST APIs, Oracle/MS SQL Server and AWS services. Led end-to-end delivery across requirements, architecture, development, testing, release management and production support for multiple enterprise applications. Designed scalable REST microservices and modular Angular applications with lazy loading, reusable components, RxJS, NgRx, secure routing and performance optimization. Modernized legacy jQuery/Vue applications into maintainable Angular architecture, improving usability, maintainability and release velocity. Built data lineage scanning capabilities to analyze ETL pipelines, Bitbucket repositories and file systems, enabling traceability for compliance and audit needs. Developed AI-driven internal tools and RAG-style automation concepts to improve knowledge discovery, Jira story analysis, lineage investigation and daily engineering productivity. Designed CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket, Ansible Tower, XLR and Datical to automate application and database deployments. Implemented secure credential management using HashiCorp Vault, service ID rotation and runtime secret retrieval aligned with enterprise security standards. Contributed to infrastructure architecture, including migration from Windows-based application servers to Linux environments and AWS-based application patterns. Owned production release coordination, vulnerability remediation, SonarQube quality improvements and cross-functional delivery with developers, QA, DevOps and business stakeholders. Awarded a patent for data visualization innovation within banking systems.

positions.title: Angular Developer
positions.description:
Played a key role in the design and development of micro frontends using Angular 16+, Module Federation, and Webpack 5, enabling team-level autonomy and faster delivery.
Containerized individual micro frontends using Docker and orchestrated them with Docker Compose for local integration testing.
Deployed and managed cloud-native applications using AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, VPC, S3, RDS, DynamoDB).
Developed shared libraries for authentication, layout, and routing used across multiple micro apps.
Integrated micro frontends dynamically within the host shell application and coordinated routing, shared state, and lazy-loaded modules.
Built and optimized CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, enabling independent deployments and blue-green release strategies.
Translated Figma designs into pixel-perfect responsive UI using SCSS, Angular Material, and Bootstrap.
Designed and developed backend services using Python (async/await, type hints) and FastAPI, implementing dependency injection, middleware, and scalable API architectures.
Participated in CI/CD pipeline setup using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Ansible Tower, managing independent deployments for each micro frontend.
Architected and implemented Micro Frontend architecture using Webpack 5 Module Federation, enabling independent deployment of domain-specific apps.
Split monolithic Angular application into independently deployable micro frontends for enhanced scalability and parallel team development.
Developed shared libraries (auth, layout, routing) to maintain design consistency and reduce duplication across multiple micro frontends.
Integrated micro frontends dynamically at runtime using host-shell architecture and unified routing for seamless user experience.
Created container registries and versioned releases in Artifactory, enabling rollback and blue-green deployments.
Refactored legacy monolith components into modular micro frontends, significantly reducing build and release time.

positions.title: Front End /Web / UI Developer
positions.description:
•	Participated in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment.
•	Designed and implemented responsive UI components using Angular 16+, TypeScript, HTML5, SCSS, and Bootstrap.
•	Containerized front-end apps using Docker, enabling consistent environments across dev/stage/prod.
•	Integrated front-end Docker containers with backend microservices using Docker Compose for full-stack testing.
•	Collaborated with UX/UI designers to translate Figma mockups into production-ready components.
•	Built dynamic forms, data tables, and charts using Angular Material and Highcharts.
•	Created and consumed RESTful APIs for secure member data retrieval and update operations.
•	Used RxJS for handling asynchronous events and streams in Angular applications.
•	Ensured WCAG/Section 508 accessibility compliance for all components using best practices and screen reader support.
•	Configured CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Ansible Tower to automate builds, tests, and deployments.
•	Diagnosed and fixed cross-browser compatibility issues using tools like Modernizr and native browser dev tools.
•	Developed unit tests and fixed test coverage issues using Karma and Jasmine to ensure build stability.
•	Monitored frontend performance using Lighthouse and Chrome DevTools, implemented lazy loading and code-splitting to optimize speed.
•	Worked closely with QA to reproduce bugs, implement fixes, and verify performance metrics in staging.
•	Used JIRA for sprint planning, user story tracking, and participated in Agile ceremonies (standups, retros, planning).
•	Implemented authentication and authorization flows using OAuth2 and JWT to secure member sessions.
•	Provided ongoing maintenance, enhancements, and bug fixes for legacy applications written in jQuery and Handlebars.js.
•	Migrated UI components from legacy frameworks to Angular as part of modernization efforts.

Configured CI/CD automation with Jenkins and Ansible Tower; improved frontend performance using Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools, lazy loading and code splitting. Collaborated with UX, QA and product teams in Agile ceremonies to deliver enhancements, bug fixes and production-ready components.

positions.title: Senior Architect
positions.description: Architected and developed enterprise metadata, data quality and lineage applications using Spring Boot, Angular, REST APIs, Oracle/MS SQL Server and AWS services. Led end-to-end delivery across requirements, architecture, development, testing, release management and production support for multiple enterprise applications. Designed scalable REST microservices and modular Angular applications with lazy loading, reusable components, RxJS, NgRx, secure routing and performance optimization. Built data lineage scanning capabilities to analyze ETL pipelines, Bitbucket repositories and file systems, enabling traceability for compliance and audit needs. Developed AI-driven internal tools and RAG-style automation concepts to improve knowledge discovery, Jira story analysis, lineage investigation and daily engineering productivity. Designed CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket, Ansible Tower, XLR and Datical to automate application and database deployments. Implemented secure credential management using HashiCorp Vault, service ID rotation and runtime secret retrieval aligned with enterprise security standards. Contributed to infrastructure architecture, including migration from Windows-based application servers to Linux environments and AWS-based application patterns. Owned production release coordination, vulnerability remediation, SonarQube quality improvements and cross-functional delivery with developers, QA, DevOps and business stakeholders. Awarded a patent for data visualization innovation within banking systems.
